title: Insight 1: Nov 1 ride breached easy ceiling by ~8 bpm
description: Your November 1 ride averaged 158 bpm, just below your Z3 threshold (159 bpm), with a max of 195 bpm. For a joyful easy ride, aim to keep average HR under 150 bpm to stay firmly in Zone 2.

title: Insight 2: Nov 6 ride packed 433 m gain into 47 km
description: That's 9.2 m/km — steep for Kolhapur's flat-rolling roads. Such vertical load adds leg fatigue; consider spreading climbing over longer rides or adding a recovery spin the next day.

title: Insight 3: Three rides in four days (Nov 5–8) flags recovery sequencing risk
description: You rode 50 km, 47 km, and 62 km on Nov 5, 6, and 8 with only one rest day. Your HRV dipped to 67 and sleep dropped to 4h55m on Nov 8. Insert an easy spin or rest day after back-to-back efforts.

title: Insight 4: Longest rides hit 62 km twice, but weekly volume fluctuates
description: You’ve done 62 km on Nov 1 and Nov 8, yet other weeks drop to 47 km. For steady happiness gains, add 5–10 km to your long ride every 2–3 weeks while keeping midweek rides easy.

title: Insight 5: HR and power zones may be misaligned — FTP 203 W vs. Garmin 271 W
description: Your estimated FTP (203 W) comes from 95 % of a 20-min effort (214 W on Oct 25). Garmin’s old 271 W is stale. A quick 20-min test or ramp test would sync zones and make easy/hard targets clearer.

title: Insight 6: Rides look mostly Zone 2, but hard spikes suggest <10 % true high-intensity time
description: Average HRs sit in Z2 (135–152 bpm), yet max HRs hit 184–195 bpm on several rides. If you want polarized benefits, dedicate one ride per week to 3–4 × 4 min at 105–110 % FTP (≈213–223 W) with full recovery.

title: Insight 7: Sleep debt building — Nov 10 only 4 h 42 m, HRV 64, readiness 80
description: Three of the last seven nights were under 6 h. Prioritize 7+ h sleep for the next week; a short noon nap can help. Your low stress (23) is good — protect it with rest.

title: Insight 8: Sprint power strong — 10-sec peak 981 W on Nov 5, 583 W on Oct 27
description: Your neuromuscular power is excellent for a casual rider. Keep it sharp with 2–3 × 10-sec all-out sprints every 10 days on a quiet road; no need for gym sessions unless you enjoy them.

title: Insight 9: VO₂max stuck at 49 — try a weekly 4 × 4 min VO₂max interval set
description: Do 4 min at 105–110 % FTP (≈213–223 W / 167–172 bpm) with 4 min easy spin, once a week for 4 weeks. Keep it fun: pick a scenic loop, no pressure to hit exact numbers.

title: Insight 10: Update FTP with a 20-min test or ramp test this month
description: Current 203 W estimate is conservative; your 1-h power on Nov 6 was 171 W (NP 180 W). A fresh test will reset training zones, making easy rides easier and hard rides appropriately hard.
